nodes.name: Lemma 6.2
nodes.statement:
Let $S$ be an FIS of $G$ of size $\alpha-k$ for some $k=O(M)$. Let $K:=|(V\setminus\overline{N}(S))\cap(F\cup R^*(S))|$ be the number of vertices $v\in V$ for which $S\cup\{v\}$ is still an independent set, but not an FIS. Finally, define $$\mathscr{P}_k(S):=\exp(P|F|+\tfrac12P|R^*(S)|+P{\bf{w}}(V)-{\bf{w}}(S))\prod_{t=k+1}^{\alpha}\frac{t-k}{n_t-K}.$$
		\begin{enumerate}[(i)]
			\item If $k=0$, then $\mathbb{P}(\boldsymbol{S}_{\alpha-k}=S)=(1+O(\mathscr{E}))\mathscr{P}_k(S)$.
			\item If $k\geq1$ with $k=O(1)$, then $\mathbb{P}(\boldsymbol{S}_{\alpha-k}=S)\leq(1+o(1))\mathscr{P}_k(S)$.
			\item If $k\geq1$, then $\mathbb{P}(\boldsymbol{S}_{\alpha-k}=S)\leq\alpha^{o(k)}\mathscr{P}_k(S)$.
		\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 6.3, Section 6.3
nodes.statement: For $p\in[0,1]$, we have the expected value $$\psi_p=K+q^2(|F|+p|R^*(S)|+{\bf{w}}(V))+O(qM^2+(n_k-K)M/\alpha).$$

nodes.name: Lemma 6.5
nodes.statement:
Consider the random variable $$\Pi:=\prod_{r=0}^{\alpha-k-1}\frac{n_{\alpha-r}-\psi_{p_r}}{n_{\alpha-r}-\Psi_r}.$$
		\begin{enumerate}[(i)]
			\item If $k=0$, then $\mathbb{E}(\Pi)=1+O(\mathscr{E})$.
			\item If $k\geq1$ with $k=O(1)$, then $\mathbb{E}(\Pi)\leq1+o(1)$.
			\item If $k\geq1$, then $\mathbb{E}(\Pi)\leq\alpha^{o(k)}$.
		\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 6.6, Lemma 6.9, Section 6.5, Section 6.10: -- --
nodes.statement:
If $k=0$, we have $\mathbb{E}(\overline{\Sigma})=O(M\log\alpha/\alpha)$.

Let $C=\Omega(1)$ be a parameter.
		\begin{enumerate}[(i)]
			\item If $k=0$ and $$C\leq\left(8\left(1-\tfrac{\log M}{\log\alpha}\right)+\Omega(1)\right)^{-1}\tfrac{\log\alpha}{\log\log\alpha},$$ then for any event $\mathcal{Q}\subset\mathcal{P}^{\delta}$ with $\delta:=\tfrac1{C}$, we have $$\mathbb{E}(\Pi1_{\mathcal{Q}})\leq(1+o(1))\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{Q})+O(\mathscr{E}).$$
			\item If $k\geq1$ and $$C\leq\left(8\left(1-\tfrac{\log M}{\log\alpha}\right)+2+\Omega(1)\right)^{-1}\tfrac{\log\alpha}{\log\log\alpha},$$ then $\mathbb{E}(e^{C\hat{\Sigma}})\leq e^{o(k)}$.
		\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 6.21, Section 6.6, Section 6.8
nodes.statement:
Let $C=\Omega(1)$ be a parameter with $$C\leq\left(8\left(1-\tfrac{\log M}{\log\alpha}\right)+\Omega(1)\right)^{-1}\tfrac{\log\alpha}{\log\log\alpha}.$$ Then there exists an event $\mathcal{R}\subset\mathcal{P}$, such that
		\begin{enumerate}[(i)]
			\item $\begin{aligned}[t]
				\mathbb{E}(\Pi1_{\mathcal{P}^{\delta}\setminus\mathcal{R}})=O(\mathscr{E})\ \text{and}\ \mathbb{E}(|1+\overline{\Sigma}|1_{\mathcal{P}^{\delta}\setminus\mathcal{R}})=O(\mathscr{E})\ \text{for}\ \delta:=\tfrac1{C}\ \text{if}\ k=0,
			\end{aligned}$
			\item $\begin{aligned}[t]
				\mathbb{E}(e^{C\Sigma^{(2)}}1_{\mathcal{P}\setminus\mathcal{R}})=o(1),
			\end{aligned}$
			\item $\begin{aligned}[t]
				C\Sigma^{(2)}=o(1)\ \text{in}\ \mathcal{R}.
			\end{aligned}$
		\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 6.22, Section 6.9
nodes.statement:
Assume $k=0$, let $\Omega(1)\leq\delta\leq1-\Omega(1)$, and let $\mathcal{R}\subset\mathcal{P}$ be an event, such that $\tfrac1{\delta}\Sigma=o(1)$ in $\mathcal{P}^{\delta}\cap\mathcal{R}$. Then
		\begin{enumerate}[(i)]
			\item $\begin{aligned}[t]
				\mathbb{E}\left(1_{\mathcal{P}^{\delta}}\sum_{r=0}^{\alpha-1}|\widetilde{Q}_r-\overline{Q}_r|\right)=O(M/\alpha),
			\end{aligned}$
			\item $\begin{aligned}[t]
				\mathbb{E}\left(1_{\mathcal{P}^{\delta}}\sum_{r=0}^{\alpha-1}\widetilde{Q}_r^2\right)=O(M/\alpha),
			\end{aligned}$
			\item $\begin{aligned}[t]
				\mathbb{E}(1_{\mathcal{P}^{\delta}\cap\mathcal{R}}(\log\Pi)^2)=O(\mathscr{E}).
			\end{aligned}$
		\end{enumerate}
		It follows that $\mathbb{E}(1_{\mathcal{P}^{\delta}\cap\mathcal{R}}(\Pi-(1+\overline{\Sigma})))=O(\mathscr{E})$.
